message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: a group helps scammers withdraw money from bank accounts. They take the bank cards and withdraw cash, then return cash to the organizer. This is facilitating fraud? The participants are taking money obtained by fraud. They are involved in the fraud as accomplices. The crime likely is "诈骗罪" (fraud) as they are part of the fraud scheme. Could also be "帮助诈骗罪" but Chinese law: participants in fraud are charged with fraud. So the crime: 诈骗 (fraud). Possibly also "组织、领导、参加诈骗犯罪集团" but typical label is 诈骗. In examples, they often label as "诈骗". So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
